details.after:
Bounded discovery pass on 2026-09-23 for entry-level US roles in the four target families, prioritizing cap-exempt employers. Used all 6 web searches and 11 of 12 page opens within the time budget. Search results were dominated by aggregators and ATS-comparison noise, so leads were drawn from a current new-grad aggregator list and then verified against live pages. Only one posting could be fully verified end-to-end: Western Governors University Associate Data Engineer (JR-025987, Salt Lake City, UT), read in full on HigherEdJobs with requisition number, duties, qualifications and salary range; the employer is a nonprofit university (cap-exempt class). Shortage explanation: two HPE graduate postings were already filled ('the job you are trying to apply for has been filled' on careers.hpe.com), Garner Health Associate Applied Scientist and Lila Sciences ML Scientist I/II no longer appear on their live Greenhouse boards, and remaining aggregator leads (UW, Tyson, SteerBridge, Cirrus Logic, Alloy.ai, Bowhead, TikTok graduate roles) could not be traced to canonical employer/ATS posting URLs within the search/page budget, so they remain unverified and are listed as rejected leads rather than upgraded. Nothing was inferred about sponsorship; the WGU posting itself says nothing about visas, so restriction_quote is empty and sponsorship_state is unknown. Coverage: cap-exempt university/national-lab angle, new-grad aggregator sweep, and direct ATS board checks (Greenhouse, HPE careers, HigherEdJobs, attempted WGU Workday). Recommend a second pass for the unverified leads.

Balanced mix shortfall:
Wanted 2 startup companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and low-competition checks.
Wanted 1 mid-sized company, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.
Wanted 2 large companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.

Excluded by the sponsorship gate (never shown as leads):
Hewlett Packard Enterprise - AI and Machine Learning Engineer I Graduate: "We're sorry… the job you are trying to apply for has been filled."
Hewlett Packard Enterprise - AI Workflow Specialist Graduate: "We're sorry… the job you are trying to apply for has been filled."
Western Governors University - Associate Data Engineer: "The posting contains no statement about visa sponsorship, work authorization, citizenship, clearance or ITAR/EAR status."

Rejected leads:
University of Washington - Research Scientist/Engineer Assistant, Department of Global Health (Temporary), Seattle WA: university (cap-exempt) lead from aggregator list ~4d old, but no canonical posting URL was obtained within budget and UW's job portal could not be searched without an additional query; unverified.
Tyson Foods - Logistics Data Engineer - Corporate 412 West, Springdale AR: strong location fit (same metro as Fayetteville AR) from aggregator list ~6d old; no canonical posting URL obtained within budget; unverified.
SteerBridge - Junior Data Engineer, Vienna VA: small-company lead from aggregator list ~3d old; careers URL unknown and no search budget remained; unverified.
Cirrus Logic - AI Applications Engineer, Austin TX: embedded-friendly lead from aggregator list ~7d old; no canonical posting URL obtained; unverified.
Garner Health - Associate Applied Scientist, New York NY (health-tech): role no longer appears on the live Greenhouse board boards.greenhouse.io/garnerhealth (board shows only Operations/People openings as of 2026-09-23); treated as inactive.
Lila Sciences - Machine Learning Scientist I/II and ML Scientist I/II - AI for Protein Engineering, San Francisco CA: neither role appears on the live Greenhouse board as of 2026-09-23 (only Corporate Development roles listed); treated as inactive; protein-design domain was also a weak profile fit.
Peraton - Junior Data Engineer / Active Secret, Beltsville MD: aggregator title indicates an active Secret clearance requirement, which the profile excludes; posting never opened, so no verbatim sentence could be captured and it is recorded here rather than as excluded-with-quote.
OneImaging - Associate Data Engineer ('Georgia Tech Only' / 'UF Only'), Miami FL: aggregator title indicates campus-restricted hiring the candidate does not qualify for; not opened.
Booz Allen / Guidehouse junior data roles (Washington DC, Arlington VA, Bethesda MD): federal consulting roles with likely clearance/US-person requirements; could not be verified within budget.
TikTok Data Engineer Graduate / MLE Graduate roles (2027 Start, San Jose/Seattle): strong family A/B fits on the aggregator list, but TikTok's JS-rendered careers site could not be reached to a canonical posting within budget; unverified.
Alloy.ai - Data Engineer, Washington DC; Bowhead - Junior Data Engineer, Stafford VA; GATX - Data Engineer, Chicago IL; Jacksonville Sheriff's Office - DATA ENGINEER I (government): aggregator leads not traceable to canonical postings within budget; unverified.
National laboratory angle (Sandia early-career postings): visible results were cleared positions requiring US citizenship/clearance eligibility; excluded by profile without opening pages.

before.title: Software Engineer- Openflow
before.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON THE SNOWFLAKE OPENFLOW TEAM, YOU WILL:

 - Design and implement features in Openflow’s control plane and data plane, contributing to reliable, scalable, and secure services that power real-time, bi-directional data movement for our customers.

 - Contribute to distributed systems for batch and streaming workloads, enabling high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines across Snowflake and non-Snowflake environments, for both structured and multi-modal unstructured data.

 - Design, scope, and deliver small projects end to end - from requirements clarification and technical design through implementation, testing, rollout, and follow-up improvements - with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to medium-sized projects with appropriate support.

 - Operate and support the components you build, including monitoring, on-call participation, incident response, and contributing to post-incident reviews and reliability improvements.

 - Apply solid engineering practices in your area, including clean code, robust testing, observability, security, and documentation, to keep our platform easy to operate and evolve.

 - Collaborate closely with peers across engineering, product, and design to clarify requirements, create technical plans, break work into milestones, and communicate progress and risks.

 - Analyze and improve performance, scalability, and reliability of existing services and pipelines, using metrics, profiling, and experimentation to guide optimizations.

 - Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and team knowledge sharing, including mentoring interns or onboarding newer engineers.

 - Contribute to shared platform tooling and patterns, helping make it easier for Openflow teams to build, deploy, and operate high-quality connectors and runtimes.


OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 2+ years of industry experience building and operating backend or platform services, including hands-on work with distributed systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and systems design, with the ability to apply them pragmatically in production code.

 - Practical experience with distributed systems concepts such as concurrency, replication, partitioning, streaming, and fault tolerance, and how they impact correctness, performance, and operability.

 - Solid understanding of operating systems and networking basics, including multithreading, memory management, storage, and debugging performance and scale issues.

 - Proficiency in Java or a similar object-oriented language, such as Scala, Go, or C++, and experience working in large, shared codebases.

 - Experience building cloud-native services on at least one major cloud provider, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, using containers, CI/CD, and modern monitoring and logging stacks.

 - A track record of delivering high-quality, maintainable solutions to non-trivial engineering problems, balancing speed with long-term reliability and simplicity.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with teammates across locations, give and receive feedback, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

 - BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience building and shipping distributed systems.

 - Bonus: Experience with data integration, observability, or streaming/flow technologies such as Apache NiFi, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow, or with analytics/data platforms.




Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

after.raw_jd:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.


AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER ON THE SNOWFLAKE OPENFLOW TEAM, YOU WILL:

 - Design and implement features in Openflow’s control plane and data plane, contributing to reliable, scalable, and secure services that power real-time, bi-directional data movement for our customers.

 - Contribute to distributed systems for batch and streaming workloads, enabling high-throughput, low-latency data pipelines across Snowflake and non-Snowflake environments, for both structured and multi-modal unstructured data.

 - Design, scope, and deliver small projects end to end - from requirements clarification and technical design through implementation, testing, rollout, and follow-up improvements - with guidance from senior engineers. Contribute to medium-sized projects with appropriate support.

 - Operate and support the components you build, including monitoring, on-call participation, incident response, and contributing to post-incident reviews and reliability improvements.

 - Apply solid engineering practices in your area, including clean code, robust testing, observability, security, and documentation, to keep our platform easy to operate and evolve.

 - Collaborate closely with peers across engineering, product, and design to clarify requirements, create technical plans, break work into milestones, and communicate progress and risks.

 - Analyze and improve performance, scalability, and reliability of existing services and pipelines, using metrics, profiling, and experimentation to guide optimizations.

 - Contribute to code reviews, design discussions, and team knowledge sharing, including mentoring interns or onboarding newer engineers.

 - Contribute to shared platform tooling and patterns, helping make it easier for Openflow teams to build, deploy, and operate high-quality connectors and runtimes.


OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 2+ years of industry experience building and operating backend or platform services, including hands-on work with distributed systems.

 - Strong computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and systems design, with the ability to apply them pragmatically in production code.

 - Practical experience with distributed systems concepts such as concurrency, replication, partitioning, streaming, and fault tolerance, and how they impact correctness, performance, and operability.

 - Solid understanding of operating systems and networking basics, including multithreading, memory management, storage, and debugging performance and scale issues.

 - Proficiency in Java or a similar object-oriented language, such as Scala, Go, or C++, and experience working in large, shared codebases.

 - Experience building cloud-native services on at least one major cloud provider, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, using containers, CI/CD, and modern monitoring and logging stacks.

 - A track record of delivering high-quality, maintainable solutions to non-trivial engineering problems, balancing speed with long-term reliability and simplicity.

 - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with teammates across locations, give and receive feedback, and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

 - BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience building and shipping distributed systems.

 - Bonus: Experience with data integration, observability, or streaming/flow technologies such as Apache NiFi, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow, or with analytics/data platforms.




Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

Bounded discovery pass on 2026-09-22 within budget (6 web searches, 12 posting pages opened). 4 entry-level US roles verified in full on the employer's own ATS page: Data Engineers at Alloy.ai (Washington DC hybrid, Lever), SmartLight Analytics (Plano TX, healthcare claims analytics, ApplyToJob) and Baselayer (San Francisco hybrid, Greenhouse), plus a Junior Machine Learning Engineer at Pangram Labs (Brooklyn NYC onsite, Ashby). None of the four verified postings contains any visa sponsorship, citizenship, clearance or ITAR/EAR wording, so restriction_quote is empty and sponsorship_state is unknown for all; the application must decide. Three additional leads were excluded with quoted sentences: Princeton Data Engineer (requires 5+ years, Mid-Senior), SteerBridge Junior Data Engineer (US citizenship + Public Trust clearance required) and MyFunded Futures Junior ML Engineer (explicitly refuses visa sponsorship). Coverage was limited by budget and access blocks: the two cap-exempt leads (WGU Associate Data Engineer on Workday; ORNL Data Engineer on jobs.ornl.gov) could not be fully verified - the Workday page requires JavaScript and the ORNL posting URL could not be obtained (aggregator copy returned HTTP 403), so neither is returned. No posting was checked against candidate files and no application action was taken. Wanted 2 startup companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and low-competition checks.

details.after:
One bounded discovery pass completed 2026-09-22 within budget (6 web searches, 12 page opens). 3 roles verified with full JD text: IXL Learning Software Engineer New Grad (posted ~1h before access, JD states H-1B sponsorship available), Garmin Embedded Software Engineer 1 (Yarmouth, ME), and DMC Entry-Level Automation Engineer (LabVIEW/TestStand/C#/Python — near-exact match to her Soliton test-automation work, but WashU campus-tagged with a 2027 start and a 3.4 GPA floor she cannot evidence). Two verified leads were excluded on the postings' own words: John Deere Embedded Software Engineer ('VISA Sponsorship is NOT available') and Visa SWE New College Grad 2027 ('Permanent Authorization... Visa will not sponsor'). Coverage shortfall: no verified Family A (Data/Analytics Engineer) or Family B (ML/AI/CV) role this pass — aggregator lists showed several (Danaher Analytics Engineer remote, HPE AI/ML Engineer I Graduate, Chan Zuckerberg Biohub MLE) but no direct posting URL could be captured and verified within budget; the LLNL computing listing rendered without job titles/URLs; the CZ Biohub Greenhouse board returned 404. Most postings were verified via aggregator (Jobright/Built In) renderings of the full employer JD; employer-direct apply URLs were not captured within the page budget and should be resolved before applying. Nothing in seen_jobs or previously_delivered overlaps these results.

Balanced mix shortfall:
Wanted 2 startup companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and low-competition checks.
Wanted 1 mid-sized company, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.
Wanted 2 large companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.

Excluded by the sponsorship gate (never shown as leads):
John Deere - Embedded Software Engineer: "VISA Sponsorship is NOT available for this position"
Visa - Software Engineer, New College Grad - 2027, Austin, TX: "Work Authorization: Permanent Authorization to work in the U.S. is a precondition of employment for this position. Visa will not sponsor applicants for work visas in connection with this position. Future sponsorship will not be considered"
DMC, Inc. - Entry Level Automation Engineer (WashU 2026): "No visa sponsorship or work-authorization sentence appears in the JD."

Rejected leads:
Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory entry-level computing roles (Livermore, CA) — the careers listing page rendered only level/date metadata without job titles or posting URLs within budget; clearance facets show many LLNL roles anticipate a DOE Q clearance, and no specific posting could be verified
Chan Zuckerberg Biohub Machine Learning Engineer, AI (Redwood City, CA) — flagged 'Sponsor' on a third-party new-grad list, but the Greenhouse board URL returned 404 and no posting page was verified
SRI International Research Engineer I/II - Embedded Development Engineer (Boulder, CO) — appeared on a new-grad aggregator list dated Sep 11, but it had aged out of the 7-day window list and no direct posting URL was captured to verify
HPE AI and Machine Learning Engineer I Graduate (San Jose, CA) and HPE Embedded Software Test Engineer Graduate (Spring, TX) — aggregator-listed with sponsor flag, but no direct posting URL captured within budget
Danaher Analytics Engineer (USA-Remote) — aggregator-listed with sponsor flag, no direct URL verified

before.title: Software Engineer - AIM Virtualization
before.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

At Snowflake, we are shaping how data becomes the center piece of the agentic enterprise. Time to value is what’s most critical to our customers. For them, moving from other platforms to Snowflake is key to unlocking new business opportunities and out-innovating their competition.

With AIM Virtualization we’re redefining interoperability for the modern data stack. Our platform makes existing applications instantly work on Snowflake by bringing the core tenets of virtualization to the database. With our runtime, customers move to Snowflake without changing SQL or APIs. As a result, AIM Virtualization makes time-consuming migrations obsolete.

Our platform is uniquely situated at the intersection of database internals and their practical application. Our team gets to tackle some of the most intricate database implementation challenges. All while pioneering an industry-first framework which customers consistently describe as “too good to be true”.

If you’re looking to work on interesting problems that truly matter to our customers while advancing how we can use AI across the organization, this is the team for you. We are looking for AI-first engineers who are not afraid to take on hard and unusual challenges. We are one of Snowflake’s leading teams in AI-driven software synthesis.

Join us if you’re looking to build systems, devise engineering processes, and direct AI systems to synthesize components of a mission critical platform.




RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Participate in AI-based development across the full platform, from syntactic and semantic analysis, to wire protocols, and data ingest/egress.

 - Collaborate with product managers, solution architects, and field engineering to enable customers make one of the most critical transitions in their database journey.

 - Define and improve our engineering processes around AI-based software synthesis workflows.


OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

 - 2-7 years of experience in SQL and/or other functional programming languages.

 - Boundless curiosity and imagination to use AI in novel ways to create a highly robust and scalable data platform.

 - Solid knowledge of database internals, including query parsing, optimization, and execution.

 - BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science: databases, high-performance computing, or related fields.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

before.title: Software Engineer (AI-Native), Database Engineering
before.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.



ABOUT THE ROLE :

You will work on critical business initiatives in the core database engine, bringing an AI-first approach to software development to accelerate roadmap cycles and deliver greater customer impact.

Your work will directly impact how developers and businesses build with data. You'll own features end-to-end while applying AI-native engineering practices across design, implementation, evaluation, deployment, measurement, and optimization.

You will thrive here if you are comfortable working in a fast-moving environment with short feedback loops, ambiguity, and a high bar for execution. We value people who take problems through completion, going beyond prototypes to deliver reliable, observable solutions with measurable outcomes.



AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Own features end-to-end for Snowflake Database Engineering products, from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production operations.

 - Design and build reliable, scalable systems for complex database and data platform workloads, with a focus on performance, correctness, and operability.

 - Lead the adoption of modern AI-driven development practices, using coding agents, automated verification, and continuous benchmarking to build higher-quality software at speed.

 - Partner with product and infrastructure teams to translate customer and engineering problems into robust product capabilities and production-ready systems.

 - Work with a highly experienced team of engineers to build and evolve core Snowflake products.



OUR IDEAL  SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. Master’s or higher degree preferred, but not required.

 - 2+ years of software engineering experience building and operating complex production systems.

 - Solid distributed systems fundamentals, with exposure to areas such as distributed execution, storage systems, concurrency, fault tolerance, performance optimization, or large-scale data processing.

 - Strong hands-on experience with AI coding agents, including advanced use across the software development lifecycle and strong intuition for model strengths, failure modes, and limitations.

 - Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C++, Java, Go, Rust or Python.

 - Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across engineering and product teams.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Power user of modern coding agents who goes beyond adoption by systematically measuring their effectiveness, identifying failure modes, and improving their use in engineering workflows.

 - Familiarity with database internals, including query languages, compilation, query optimization or execution, semantic layers, or large-scale storage and retrieval systems.


Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.



Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

details.before:
Bounded pass completed 2026-09-22: 6/6 web searches and 12/12 page opens used. Sources were a sponsorship-oriented new-grad list (Simplify), a GitHub-tracked 2027 AI/data new-grad list with direct ATS links, and targeted searches for cap-exempt and test-automation roles. Four postings were verified end-to-end on the employer's own ATS page (WGU on its own careers portal, Alloy.ai on Lever, Baselayer on Greenhouse, SmartLight Analytics on its ApplyToJob career page); all are US-located, entry-level, and in the Data Engineer family. No posting contained any visa, citizenship, clearance, or ITAR/EAR language, so all restriction_quote fields are empty and sponsorship_state is unknown everywhere — the application must decide. One lead (SteerBridge Junior Data Engineer) was excluded after verification because its posting states 'U.S. Citizenship required' plus a Public Trust clearance requirement. Coverage gaps: TikTok ML Engineer Graduate and GATX Data Engineer pages returned only boilerplate (JS-rendered), so they were not verifiable within budget and are listed as rejected leads; family (C) pure SWE and family (D) embedded/test roles in reach of the budget were dominated by defense employers (SpaceX, Anduril, Peraton, True Anomaly, Rhombus) whose titles/snippets signaled clearance or US-person requirements, so none were delivered. The WGU role is the priority target: a university employer (cap-exempt, files H-1B year-round) with an Associate-level data engineering posting. Returned 4 of the allowed 5 because no fifth posting could be verified within the page budget; all four are distinct companies and none match seen_jobs or previously_delivered.

Balanced mix shortfall:
Wanted 2 startup companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and low-competition checks.
Wanted 1 mid-sized company, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.
Wanted 2 large companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.

Excluded by the sponsorship gate (never shown as leads):
SteerBridge - Junior Data Engineer: "U.S. Citizenship required; Must hold, or be able to obtain, a Public Trust clearance (an active Secret or Top Secret clearance also satisfies this requirement)"

Rejected leads:
TikTok - Machine Learning Engineer Graduate, E-Commerce Recommendation Video (2027 Start), San Jose, CA (https://lifeattiktok.com/search/7686999927260105013): page fetch returned only compensation/benefits/D&I boilerplate; the JD body and any work-authorization language did not render, so the posting could not be verified within budget and was not delivered.
GATX - Data Engineer, Chicago, IL (https://careers-gatx.icims.com/jobs/4705/data-engineer/job): iCIMS page returned only EEO/accommodation boilerplate; requirements and authorization language did not render, so it was not verifiable.
Peraton - Junior Data Engineer / Active Secret, Beltsville, MD: title in the aggregator listing itself requires an active Secret clearance, which the candidate cannot hold as an F-1 nonimmigrant; not opened to conserve budget.
True Anomaly - Data Engineer I, Denver, CO; SpaceX - Integration & Test Engineer, Bastrop, TX; Anduril - 2026 Early Career Flight Test Engineer, Costa Mesa, CA; Rhombus - Data Engineer (Secret/Top Secret), Washington, DC: defense/space employers whose listings signal ITAR/US-person or clearance requirements; not opened to conserve budget, and none could be delivered without verifying a restriction sentence.
OneImaging - Associate Data Engineer, Miami, FL: two postings explicitly restricted to Georgia Tech and University of Florida graduates respectively; candidate attends University of Arkansas, so ineligible.
hatch I.T. - Junior Data Engineer (DEA), Arlington, VA and Bowhead - Junior Data Engineer, Stafford, VA: federal-contractor roles in the VA/DC corridor with strong likelihood of citizenship/Public Trust requirements (confirmed pattern in the verified SteerBridge exclusion); skipped to conserve budget.
Palantir - Software Engineer, New Grad (Lever results): surfaced postings were London-based or UK-government-facing, outside the US-only scope.
WGU HigherEdJobs mirror (https://www.higheredjobs.com/admin/details.cfm?JobCode=179538987) and both Workday URLs (wgu.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com) failed to render; WGU was verified instead on its own careers portal (jobs.wgu.edu).

before.title: Software Engineer - Database Engineering
before.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re hiring talented Software Engineers to join the Snowflake Database Engineering https://snowflake.phenompro.com/us/en/database-engineering team! In this role you will work directly with our team to evolve our elastic, large scale, high-performance data processing system. We need smart engineers who can pick up and understand complex technical areas quickly – and who are enthusiastic about building new technologies!



AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:

 - Design, develop, and support a petabyte-scale cloud database that is highly parallel and fault-tolerant.

 - Build high-quality and highly reliable software to meet the needs of some of the largest companies on the planet.

 - Analyze and understand performance and scalability bottlenecks in the system and solve them.

 - Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions.

 - Design and implement novel query optimization or distributed data processing algorithms which allow Snowflake to provide industry leading data warehousing capabilities.

 - Design and implement the new service architecture required to enable the Snowflake Data Cloud

 - Develop tools for improving our customers' insights into their workloads.



OUR IDEAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER WILL HAVE:

 - 2+ years industry experience working on commercial or open-source software.

 - Fluency in Java or C++.

 - Familiarity with development in a Linux environment.

 - Excellent problem solving skills, and strong CS fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.

 - Systems programming skills including multi-threading, concurrency, etc.

 - Experience with implementation testing, debugging and documentation.

 - Bachelor’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related field; Masters or PhD preferred.

 - Ability to work on-site in our Menlo Park / Bellevue / Berlin office.
   

BONUS POINTS FOR EXPERIENCE WITH THE FOLLOWING:

 - SQL or other database technologies including internal design and implementation.

 - Query optimization, query execution, compiler design and implementation.

 - Experience with internals of distributed key value stores like FoundationDB and storage engines like RocksDB, InnoDB, BerkeleyDB etc.

 - Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL internals

 - Data warehouse design, database systems, and large-scale data processing solutions like Hadoop and Spark.

 - Large scale distributed systems, transactions and consistency models.

 - Experience in database replication technology

 - Big data storage technologies and their applications, e.g., HDFS, Cassandra, Columnar Databases, etc.
   

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

Software Engineer, Web Products

P-1581

Location: Mountain View, CA

About Us:

The Web Engineering team at Databricks builds and owns the public-facing web experiences that represent Databricks to the world, across databricks.com, the blog, landing pages, hubs, microsites, and event properties. We are rebuilding the platform from the ground up, AI native from the start, and pioneering an agentic SDLC as our operating model.

The Role:

As Software Engineer on the Web Engineering team, you will build and ship production-quality web experiences across public-facing Databricks properties on an AI native platform designed for humans and agents from the ground up. You will contribute to a web delivery practice where AI native tools and an AI native engineering lifecycle are embedded in how the team builds every day.

The impact you’ll have :

- Build and ship web experiences across databricks.com including landing pages, blogs, hubs, and event properties on a unified, AI native architectural foundation

- Implement components and page systems using a shared design system, contributing to a consolidated stack that reduces per-surface maintenance overhead

- Operate in an AI native SDLC where agents assist across code generation, testing, and deployment, building faster and more reliably alongside them

- Contribute to ensuring databricks.com surfaces are structured and optimized for how the web is discovered and consumed today, including by AI driven search and discovery systems

- Participate actively in code review and help establish what rigorous, AI native engineering execution looks like on this team

What we look for:

- 4+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of shipping production web systems

- Strong fundamentals across the web stack including component architecture, rendering strategies, build systems, and deployment pipelines

- Experience building on or integrating with content management systems like Drupal, Contentful

- Comfort adopting AI native development tools and embedding them into daily engineering practice

- Ability to take a well-scoped problem and drive it to completion under senior direction

- Familiarity with headless CMS architectures, edge delivery, or modern frontend frameworks is a strong plus

AI Engineer – Forward Deployed Engineering (AI FDE) (ALL LEVELS)

CSQ327R177

Mission

The AI Forward Deployed Engineering (AI FDE) team is a highly specialized customer-facing AI team at Databricks. We deliver professional services engagements to help our customers build and productionize first-of-its-kind AI applications. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations, as well as support internal subject matter expert (SME) teams. We view our team as an ensemble: we look for individuals with strong, unique specializations to improve the overall strength of the team. This team is the right fit for you if you love working with customers, teammates, and fueling your curiosity for the latest trends in GenAI, LLMOps, and ML more broadly. Open to remote locations.

This role is intended for experienced engineers with demonstrated industry experience designing, building, and deploying production GenAI and LLM applications at scale. It is not intended for internship, new graduate, or entry-level applicants.

The impact you will have:

- Develop cutting-edge GenAI solutions, incorporating the latest techniques from Databricks AI research to solve customer problems

- Own production rollouts of consumer and internally facing GenAI applications

- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers across a variety of domains

- Present at conferences such as Data + AI Summit , recognized as a thought leader internally and externally

- Collaborate cross-functionally with the product and engineering teams to influence priorities and shape the product roadmap

What we look for:

- Experience building GenAI applications, including RAG, multi-agent systems, Text2SQL, fine-tuning, etc., with tools such as HuggingFace, LangChain, and DSPy

- Expertise in deploying production-grade GenAI applications, including evaluation and optimizations

- Extensive years of hands-on industry data science experience, leveraging common machine learning and data science tools, i.e. pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, etc.

- Experience building production-grade machine learning deployments on AWS, Azure, or GCP

- Graduate degree in a quantitative discipline (Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Operations Research, etc.) or equivalent practical experience

- Experience communicating and/or teaching technical concepts to non-technical and technical audiences alike

- Passion for collaboration, life-long learning, and driving business value through AI

- [Preferred] Experience using the Databricks Intelligence Platform and Apache Spark™ to process large-scale distributed datasets

- Willing to travel once every 4-8 weeks to see customers (as needed)

To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Snowflake started with a clear vision: develop a cloud data platform that is effective, affordable, and accessible to all data users. Data Cloud allows sharing live data in governed and secure ways so our customers can solve their business problems.

Data Cloud allows sharing live data in governed and secure ways so our customers can solve their business problems. Come join our world-class team as a Software Engineer to build the backend services for data cloud to help our customers to share data internally within their company or outside with external organizations.

We are investing in initiatives across multiple engineering areas that include: Data Engineering & Open Lakehouse, Database Engineering, Engineering Systems, Product Experiences, Apps & Collaboration,Platform Engineering, and Public Sector, Security and Governance




AS A SOFTWARE ENGINEER, YOU WILL:

 - Design and build features, and/or distributed platforms at scale. 

 - Drive impactful initiatives for the globally distributed infrastructure

 - Collaborate with product managers, architects, other engineering teams, and business groups, to drive end-to-end solutions.

 - Contribute to improving our engineering processes, tooling, and standards.


OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE:

 - 2-7 years’ of industry experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

 - Strong fundamental computer science skills. Knowledge of algorithms and data structures.

 - Fluency in Java, Python, C++, or SQL 

 - Deep multi-faceted appreciation in building end-to-end customer facing products.

 - BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related majors, or equivalent experience.
   


BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: 

 - Familiarity with database internals or data governance, and/or payment systems is a plus
   

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

details.after:
Bounded pass completed 2026-09-22: 6/6 web searches and 12/12 page opens used. Sources were a sponsorship-oriented new-grad list (Simplify), a GitHub-tracked 2027 AI/data new-grad list with direct ATS links, and targeted searches for cap-exempt and test-automation roles. Four postings were verified end-to-end on the employer's own ATS page (WGU on its own careers portal, Alloy.ai on Lever, Baselayer on Greenhouse, SmartLight Analytics on its ApplyToJob career page); all are US-located, entry-level, and in the Data Engineer family. No posting contained any visa, citizenship, clearance, or ITAR/EAR language, so all restriction_quote fields are empty and sponsorship_state is unknown everywhere — the application must decide. One lead (SteerBridge Junior Data Engineer) was excluded after verification because its posting states 'U.S. Citizenship required' plus a Public Trust clearance requirement. Coverage gaps: TikTok ML Engineer Graduate and GATX Data Engineer pages returned only boilerplate (JS-rendered), so they were not verifiable within budget and are listed as rejected leads; family (C) pure SWE and family (D) embedded/test roles in reach of the budget were dominated by defense employers (SpaceX, Anduril, Peraton, True Anomaly, Rhombus) whose titles/snippets signaled clearance or US-person requirements, so none were delivered. The WGU role is the priority target: a university employer (cap-exempt, files H-1B year-round) with an Associate-level data engineering posting. Returned 4 of the allowed 5 because no fifth posting could be verified within the page budget; all four are distinct companies and none match seen_jobs or previously_delivered.

Balanced mix shortfall:
Wanted 2 startup companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and low-competition checks.
Wanted 1 mid-sized company, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.
Wanted 2 large companies, found 0 that passed relevance, legitimacy and sponsorship evidence.

Excluded by the sponsorship gate (never shown as leads):
SteerBridge - Junior Data Engineer: "U.S. Citizenship required; Must hold, or be able to obtain, a Public Trust clearance (an active Secret or Top Secret clearance also satisfies this requirement)"

Rejected leads:
TikTok - Machine Learning Engineer Graduate, E-Commerce Recommendation Video (2027 Start), San Jose, CA (https://lifeattiktok.com/search/7686999927260105013): page fetch returned only compensation/benefits/D&I boilerplate; the JD body and any work-authorization language did not render, so the posting could not be verified within budget and was not delivered.
GATX - Data Engineer, Chicago, IL (https://careers-gatx.icims.com/jobs/4705/data-engineer/job): iCIMS page returned only EEO/accommodation boilerplate; requirements and authorization language did not render, so it was not verifiable.
Peraton - Junior Data Engineer / Active Secret, Beltsville, MD: title in the aggregator listing itself requires an active Secret clearance, which the candidate cannot hold as an F-1 nonimmigrant; not opened to conserve budget.
True Anomaly - Data Engineer I, Denver, CO; SpaceX - Integration & Test Engineer, Bastrop, TX; Anduril - 2026 Early Career Flight Test Engineer, Costa Mesa, CA; Rhombus - Data Engineer (Secret/Top Secret), Washington, DC: defense/space employers whose listings signal ITAR/US-person or clearance requirements; not opened to conserve budget, and none could be delivered without verifying a restriction sentence.
OneImaging - Associate Data Engineer, Miami, FL: two postings explicitly restricted to Georgia Tech and University of Florida graduates respectively; candidate attends University of Arkansas, so ineligible.
hatch I.T. - Junior Data Engineer (DEA), Arlington, VA and Bowhead - Junior Data Engineer, Stafford, VA: federal-contractor roles in the VA/DC corridor with strong likelihood of citizenship/Public Trust requirements (confirmed pattern in the verified SteerBridge exclusion); skipped to conserve budget.
Palantir - Software Engineer, New Grad (Lever results): surfaced postings were London-based or UK-government-facing, outside the US-only scope.
WGU HigherEdJobs mirror (https://www.higheredjobs.com/admin/details.cfm?JobCode=179538987) and both Workday URLs (wgu.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com) failed to render; WGU was verified instead on its own careers portal (jobs.wgu.edu).
